answer: Each identity keeps a fixed, tamper-sealed camera streaming signed frames hourly from one unique meadow plot. Verifiers match horizon shadows and weather to the claimed site and satellite records, and monthly post a random flag colour the holder must plant in frame within 60 minutes; a mismatch or missed flag revokes the slot. One plot cannot serve two views, so 1,000 Sybils need 1,000 plots, cameras and uplinks at $55 monthly each ($55,000 monthly) plus site rent. Trade-off: checks pause at night, when the sun nears its nadir, and in storms, slowing admission.
